sections.Profile:
The Loop the Loop pinball machine, manufactured by Bally in 1966, is an electro-mechanical game designed by Ted Zale.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1966
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Arts & Entertainment, Carnival, Circus, Original Theme

- Design: Ted Zale
- Mechanics: Ted Zale
- Concept: Ted Zale
